name: complete rectangular windows and absolute coordinates
input: 3 by 4 grid, 2 by 2 window, row stride one, column stride two
test:
values = [[1, 3, 2, 0], [4, 6, 5, 1], [7, 2, 9, 8]]
pooled, locations = max_pool_with_locations(values, 2, 2, 1, 2)
assert pooled == [[6, 5], [7, 9]]
assert locations == [[(1, 1), (1, 2)], [(2, 0), (2, 2)]]

name: drops incomplete edge windows
input: 3 by 4 grid, 2 by 2 window, stride two in both dimensions
test:
pooled, locations = max_pool_with_locations([[1, 4, 9, 2], [5, 3, 6, 8], [7, 0, 1, 10]], 2, 2, 2, 2)
assert pooled == [[5, 9]]
assert locations == [[(1, 0), (0, 2)]]

name: row-major tie order in overlapping windows
test:
values = [[5, 1, 5], [2, 5, 0], [1, 1, 3]]
pooled, locations = max_pool_with_locations(values, 2, 2, 1, 1)
assert pooled == [[5, 5], [5, 5]]
assert locations == [[(0, 0), (0, 2)], [(1, 1), (1, 1)]]

name: negative values in a non-square window
test:
values = [[-9, -3, -8], [-4, -7, -2], [-6, -5, -1]]
pooled, locations = max_pool_with_locations(values, 2, 3, 1, 1)
assert pooled == [[-2], [-1]]
assert locations == [[(1, 2)], [(2, 2)]]
